objectives.text: Apply components, props, state, effects, routing, forms and context together on short mixed problems, including every re-render trigger taught (a state update, a parent re-render and a changed context value)
Diagnose common React bugs (mutated state, a missing or unstable key, a wrong dependency array, an unhandled error status) and name the fix

minutes.basis: intake-plan: no page exists yet, so modeledP50 and modeledWorstPath are planning targets, not measurements. Targets: estimator P50 at most 8 minutes and worst required path (two wrong graded attempts and wrong-first explores per interactive unit) at most 10 minutes, set just above the measured course-1 range (estimator P50 4.78-7.95, worst path 6-9.35; evidence/git-linux-ai-foundations/intake.md). budget = ceil(max(modeledP50, modeledWorstPath)) per docs/tools/validators.md, capped at 15; aboutLabel covers the worst path. The module PR replaces modeledP50 with the frozen estimator's P50 on the page bytes and modeledWorstPath with the authored worst-path model, then re-derives budget and aboutLabel by the same rule. See evidence/react/intake.md, section Minute budgets.
